purpose: Reusable all-team road-to-premiership model for future seasons, including 2027.
season_application: Populate for every NRL club from Round 1 onward; update after each verified result and ladder change.
principle: Every team's premiership road is tracked, not only current favourites or finalists.

positions_1_to_4.win: Advance directly to Preliminary Final and receive Week 2 off.
positions_1_to_4.loss: Remain alive and host a Week 2 Semi-final against an Elimination Final winner.
premiership_routes: Qualifying Final win -> Preliminary Final win -> Grand Final win
Qualifying Final loss -> Semi-final win -> Preliminary Final win -> Grand Final win

positions_5_to_8.premiership_route: Elimination Final win -> Semi-final win -> Preliminary Final win -> Grand Final win

finals_mechanics.week_3: Preliminary Finals are sudden death; winners reach the Grand Final.
finals_mechanics.week_4: Grand Final winner is NRL Premier.

2026_final_eight_reference.note: The 2026 final eight was locked before Round 27. Exact seeding and pathways must be reconciled after the final regular-season result rather than inferred from an earlier ladder snapshot.

2027_build_rule: From the first 2027 ladder, maintain one road record for every NRL club. A team remains represented after mathematical elimination, with the elimination mechanism and date preserved for season audit.
